bug: The attendance calendar marks every working day as Absent for TKF9010 - Aug 2026 (25 Absent), Sep 2026 (26 Absent) and Oct 2026 (24 Absent) - including months/days before the employee was created; Saturdays are counted as working days and previous months can be opened without any limit.

bug: Holidays configured in HR for 26-Aug-2026 (demo leave) and 31-Aug-2026 (demo) are shown as Absent in the employee calendar; only the 15-Aug national holiday shows as Holiday, the employee Office Location is blank so location-wise holidays cannot apply, and there is no Holiday count tile.

bug: TRUE HR's QA Test Holiday (24-12-2026) is shown as a Holiday in the attendance calendar of the Company Admin organisation's employee (TH5001).

bug: Miss-Punch has no validation: invalid days 0,32,abc (Oct 2026), future dates (5-Nov-2026, 5-Dec-2026) and a very old date (10-Jan-2019) are accepted; the same day can be applied twice (two PENDING requests for 5-Dec-2026); Submit with empty days shows no message; Year is a free-text box and abcd gives days, month and year are required; there are no In/Out time fields and a pending request cannot be cancelled.

bug: Full annual leave balances are given immediately to a new joiner (EL 10/10, CL 12/12, SL 12/12) without proration, and Maternity Leave (182) and Menstrual Leave (12) are shown and can be applied regardless of gender - Maternity Leave for 21-12-2026 was accepted for TKF9010 (Subham Tripathy).

bug: A leave can be applied when the employee has no reporting manager (LWP for 03-11-2026 was accepted as PENDING) and My Leaves does not show who the approver is, so the request can never be approved.
note: Block or route to HR when no approver exists, and show the pending approver.

bug: Leaves cannot be taken on adjacent days (You must keep at least one day gap between leaves), so e.g. CL on Monday + SL on Tuesday is blocked.
testData: Any leave on the day next to an existing leave
note: Adjacent leaves of different types should follow the leave policy (sandwich rule), not be blocked outright.

bug: Sick Leave can be applied for a past date (01-10-2026) and Restricted Holiday can be applied on a normal working day (18-11-2026) that is not in the RH list; both are accepted as PENDING.

bug: Half day has no First half / Second half selection, and Half day can be ticked for a multi-day range: CL 07-12-2026 to 09-12-2026 with Half day was accepted and counted as only 0.5 day.

note: Half day should be allowed only when From = To, with First/Second half selection.

bug: Leave balance cards do not change after a leave is applied and is pending (CL still shows 12/12), while applying CL for 01-12-2026 to 31-12-2026 says 'Insufficient balance - 11 day(s) available (pending requests reserved)'; the card and the actual available balance do not match.
testData: CL 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-31 with one CL pending
note: Balance cards should show available balance after reserving pending requests.

bug: Work From Home is accepted although its balance shows 0 / 0, and Reason is optional for all leave types (EL 14-12-2026 was applied with a blank reason).
note: Balance display and validation should match, and Reason should be mandatory.

bug: Cancelling a pending leave happens immediately without a confirmation, and the Cancelled tab does not show the cancelled date or who cancelled it.
note: Cancel should ask for confirmation and the Cancelled tab should show cancelled date/by.

bug: There is no attachment option while applying leave (e.g. medical certificate for Sick Leave or Maternity Leave), and no holiday / restricted-holiday list is shown in Leave; the holiday list is available only as a PDF under Policies, so the employee cannot see valid RH dates while applying.
testData: Apply Leave > Sick Leave / Maternity Leave / Restricted Holiday
note: Allow document upload for SL/ML (mandatory beyond policy days) and show the holiday and RH list in the Leave screen.

bug: Leave balances (EL 6, CL 5, SL 7) come from the Odisha state-entitlement row, not from the Leave types annual quota configured by the admin (EL 10, CL 12, SL 12), and the full yearly quota is given to an employee who joined on 02-11-2026 without proration.
testData: Company Admin org employee TH5001 - TH5001 > Leave > My Balances
note: Make the quota source clear and prorate for mid-year joiners.

bug: Comp-Off shows no credits, clicking Apply with nothing selected gives no message, and there is no option in web ESS to apply OD / holiday work to earn comp-off.
note: Comp-off credits should be listed, empty apply should show a validation message and OD should be applicable from ESS.

bug: Create NFA shows raw technical errors on submit: 'businessOperationId is required; groupCompanyId is required; projectId is required; expenseCategoryId is required; zoneId is required; locationId is required'.
note: Show user-friendly field-level messages (e.g. 'Business operation is required').

bug: NFA expense line amounts are not validated properly: negative NFA and logistic amounts (-500 / -100) are rejected with the misleading message Pick an expense header and enter an amount, yet a negative logistic amount (-1) with a positive NFA amount is accepted; Rs 0.001 and Rs 9,99,99,99,99,999 are accepted and the same header can be added twice (Grand Total Rs 9,99,99,99,99,999.001).

bug: Create NFA dropdowns contain junk/test master values - Business Operation cvf, Client/Vendor Dmeo, Projects BJP Call Center / BJP Surveyor - and Location mixes a state (Odisha) with cities and Client-Side; in HR admin login the NFA Masters page shows No entries, so HR cannot see or clean these values.

bug: NFA20260004 was created with settlement date 01-01-2020 (past date accepted).

bug: NFA detail page shows raw values (ADVANCE SELF, NON BILLABLE) and does not list the expense lines entered.

bug: Purchase Request NFA type opens the same form as Expense NFA (no item, quantity or vendor quote fields).

bug: Status filters with no results (e.g. APPROVED) say Create your first NFA to see it here even though the employee already has an NFA.

bug: The Create NFA and Upload Agreement dropdowns mix another organisation's masters (BJP Call Center, True Kind Foundation, True Jobs, cvf, Dmeo, Noida...) with Company Admin's own; Staffing and Bhubaneswar appear twice; the NFA number NFA20260005 continues the other organisation's sequence; the approval chain lists the requester himself as Finance approver and is stuck at Reporting Manager although the Approvers page says empty stages are skipped.

bug: The KPI for October 2026 is stuck at RM PENDING because TKF9010 has no reporting manager; the system allows KPI submission without an RM and gives no warning.

bug: Achievement bands show 120-infinity% and KPI rows have no Target / Actual fields.

bug: Assign Task is shown to an employee with no team: the Assign to dropdown is empty, clicking Assign Task with all fields empty does nothing and shows no message, and the field label AROUND TIME is unclear.

bug: Formats under Policies (Star Of The Month Nomination Form, Reimbursement Form) can only be downloaded; there is no place anywhere in ESS to fill and upload them back - no Upload/Submit on Policies, no attachment in Create NFA or Support, and no R&R / nomination module - so the filled form cannot be submitted to HR in the system.
